error TS2300: Duplicate identifier 'Point'.


!!! error TS2300: Duplicate identifier 'Point'.
==== TwoInternalModulesThatMergeEachWithExportedClassesOfTheSameName.ts (0 errors) ====
    namespace A {
        export class Point {
            x: number;
            y: number;
        }
    }
    
    namespace A{
        // expected error
        export class Point {
            origin: number;
            angle: number;
        }
    }
    
    namespace X.Y.Z {
        export class Line {
            length: number;
        }
    }
    
    namespace X {
        export namespace Y {
            export namespace Z {
                // expected error
                export class Line {
                    name: string;
                }
            }
        }
    }
